The mortgage stress test, explained in 7 slides. For uninsured mortgages, OSFI's minimum qualifying rate is the greater of your contract rate plus 2% or 5.25%. You still pay your contract rate; the higher rate is only used to test affordability. Insured mortgages have their own rules, so ask your lender. Examples are illustrative, not rate quotes.
